Question
========
A 4-way set associative cache with 128 rows requires how many tag comparators?


Answerlist
----------
* 4
* 128
* 512
* 1

Solution
========
The row index selects a single row, and inside that row the tags of the ways are compared in parallel. Only the associativity matters, so 4 comparators are needed, whatever the number of rows.

Answerlist
----------
* 1. One comparator per way; the number of rows does not matter.
* 0. The row is selected by decoding the index, not by comparing every row.
* 0. This would be one comparator per cacheline of the whole cache.
* 0. A single comparator would force the ways to be checked one after the other.
